work_packages.name: Program contract and dependency lock
exit_gate: master roadmap is accepted
component roadmaps map to master IDs
shared status vocabulary is used
docs merge is not treated as implementation completion

work_packages.name: Multi-tenant production foundation
exit_gate: real PostgreSQL and runtime cross-tenant negative E2E passes
production schema, bridge, secret, OAuth and readback are executed
retry and redelivery side effects are bounded and auditable
not_collected is never treated as pass or zero

work_packages.name: Shared Judgment DAG kernel
exit_gate: Context to Evaluation DAG runs deterministically
missing, cyclic and reverse-layer dependencies fail before execution
run input, output, artifact and version are readable
organization edition consumes the same semantics without fork

work_packages.name: Canonical Company Authority
exit_gate: 2 tenant x 2 person x read/write/approval/deny fresh E2E passes
unknown, ambiguous, inactive, out-of-scope and stale revision fail closed
Mana does not synthesize person, organization, project, owner or approver
authority, execution, usage and receipt share one correlation ID

work_packages.name: Replay and evaluation primitives
exit_gate: historical version replays against recorded context
version comparison does not rewrite history
evaluation cannot mutate the evaluated event set

work_packages.name: Personal boundary and scope promotion
exit_gate: cross-person Personal KG non-leakage passes
owner approval alone writes zero Graph records
organization reviewer cannot read Personal body
Graph cannot reconstruct Personal body
LLM repetition alone cannot promote knowledge

work_packages.name: Governed execution and approval runtime
exit_gate: same node runs through human and agent under one input contract
agent confidence cannot override authority
unauthorized approver, stale context and missing accountable owner fail closed
execution artifact is bound to authority receipt

work_packages.name: OSS and Organization complete conformance
exit_gate: all OSS public contracts pass in organization CI at an exact version
authentication, tenant, authority and failure semantics conform
local-only features are safely adapted or explicit non_applicable
no separate organization Judgment DAG semantic implementation exists

work_packages.name: Brainbase Deployment DAG dogfood
exit_gate: one real deployment runs end-to-end
all Keigo-only judgments are explicit human-run nodes
expert escalation count per deployment is measurable
at least one repeated judgment is promoted into a reusable node

work_packages.name: Internal multi-user proof
exit_gate: each lane closes at least one real work Ship
person, tenant, project, authority, artifact and readback are traceable
boundary incident count is zero
user value is recorded, not only technical success

work_packages.name: Mana management execution loop
exit_gate: same governed contract is reused in Umeda and TechKnight work
Mana closes executable work to Ship
human decisions are routed to canonical owner or approver and stale work is detected
Mana does not synthesize authority or upstream judgment

work_packages.name: Growin design-partner proof
exit_gate: at least one evidence-to-outcome judgment chain operates live
current policy, evidence, change authority and downstream impact are answerable
invalid and superseded judgments are not returned as current
Growin-specific requirements are separated from reusable core

work_packages.name: Second-company portability proof
exit_gate: same DAG semantics are reused without schema fork
reusable nodes are reused or explicitly versioned
customer adapters remain outside shared core
comparable phases require fewer Keigo escalations than the first company

work_packages.name: Organizational replay and backtest
exit_gate: past organizational judgment replays from recorded context
proposed version comparison does not alter history
insufficient causal evidence is not converted into certainty
evaluation connects to promotion or supersession candidates

work_packages.name: Enterprise production
exit_gate: enterprise controls wrap the shared DAG model without semantic fork
customer production operation has explicit authority and audit trail
failure drill, restore, credential rotation and tenant deletion are readable
V2, R2 and O0 outcomes remain valid on the production path
